newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Enron Corp Philippines unit net rises.
newsitem.headline: Enron Corp Philippines unit net rises.

text.p: The Philippines' Subic Power Corp, an affiliate of Enron Corp, said on Monday it made a net 143.22 million peso profit in 1996 compared with 140.86 million the previous year.
Operating revenues rose to 840.75 million pesos against 830.19 million in 1995. Income from operations dropped to 358.39 million pesos from 382.56 million in 1995.
Enron Power Philippines Corp, a unit of Enron Corp, is the is the major shareholder with 50 percent. EEI Corp has a 20 percent stake.
At present, Subic Power operates a 108-megawatt bunker fuel-fired power plant in Subic, Zambales, north of the capital.
